title: Parent and dependency writes through kanbus-api
description: The API rejects parent changes, dependency writes, hierarchical type changes and deleting issues with children (unsupported_relation_mutation) because the journal only has per-object revisions and no cross-record invariants. Bot boards need parent/child. Design the cross-record write (e.g. a journaled multi-object intent that validates the hierarchy rule and parent existence, with deterministic recovery) and spec it.
